notes: Sourced from Epiphan's own tech-specs pages (marketing site and user guide), which agree. Video Pearl Mini is a desktop unit (no rack ears standard), hence rackUnits omitted. HDMI in/out are HDMI 1.4a rated (hdmi-1.4). SDI input is 3G-SDI (sdi-3g). Ethernet RJ-45 is 10/100/1000BASE-T (eth-1g); this single port carries network video I/O (RTSP/SRT/NDI|HX in, H.264 streaming out) in addition to control/management, so it is modeled as one bidirectional network port rather than separate video-only ports. USB-A ports are rated USB 3.0 (usb-5g): one front-panel (general host, e.g. for USB drives) and two rear-panel (UVC/UAC — accept USB webcams/mics as capture inputs, hence "bidirectional" direction fits their host role, though signal-flow-wise they primarily function as inputs when used with a UVC camera or UAC mic). Audio combo jacks are XLR3 with TRS-6.35 accepted (combo jack). Power is an external AC/DC adapter outputting 12VDC 5A (60W or 84W depending on adapter variant); connector on the unit is a barrel-style DC input, modeled as dc-barrel - exact barrel size not stated by Epiphan. No separate SDI audio-only ports are broken out since SDI/HDMI/USB carry embedded audio through the same physical connector already listed under video.
